products.name: 3D-Printed Traditional Kumkum Chimil (Chittie / Storage Box)
products.description:
Elevate your pooja setup and traditional gift collections with our intricately designed 3D-printed Kumkum Chimil. Built to blend cultural tradition with modern precision, this compact container is ideal for storing kumkum, turmeric (haldi), sandal paste (chandan), or small sacred keepsakes.
​Key Features:
​Intricate Traditional Design: Styled with classic Indian motifs, featuring a smooth, secure lid to keep contents fresh and spill-free.
​Lightweight & Durable: Engineered from high-quality, eco-friendly plastic—resistant to drops, unlike traditional brass or clay containers.
​Multi-Purpose Use: Perfect for daily home pooja essentials, temple visits, car dashboards, or return gifts for functions.
​Vibrant Finishes: Available in rich metallic shades (like Silk Gold and Antique Brass) and classic colors.
